scope: Two owned PNGs imported behind a real empty search filter; A first renders a fresh thumbnail and B first displays a persisted independently encoded JPEG.

Two 256 MiB sparse regular .jpg files seed the actual 512 MiB disk cap, each required to allocate less than 1 MiB. Distinct old modification times make eviction order unambiguous. Non-JPEG marker, current JPEGs, originals and catalog remain intact.

Recreate the real ThumbnailProvider on the actual engine at an idle boundary. B has never appeared in QML, eliminating Qt pixmap-cache reuse. Its original is temporarily hidden; a real successful worker response and texture factory invocation are required, proving use of persisted disk pixels.

Real UI filename filters and scene readback verify both displayed thumbnails against independently rendered/encoded JPEGs. The complete two-asset document/revision/path/checksum state is unchanged. Sparse files are removed on successful and failed exits.
fix: Under cacheMutex, trim the persisted cache at the first successful cache hit of each provider lifetime. Mark a successful cache publication as already checked; every new publication still trims. Subsequent hits do not rescan the directory.
